description: On the table there’s a small pile of colorful plastic utensils (spoons and forks) and, to the right, a wire rack with a small rectangular metal container. The left hand reaches in from the left, scoops up a handful of the utensils from the pile, lifts them, and inserts them into the metal container; it then returns to pick up the remaining utensils and places those into the same container before releasing.
